name: Anjali Dawnbloom
lore: A proud court archer from a hill town where archers plant a flowering branch to mark the ground they have sworn to defend. She came to Crossroads looking for a rival who could match her aim.
passive: Stand Tall: a fully drawn Courtbow near your branch grants a brief shield.

primary.name: Courtbow
primary.description: Tap for one arrow. Hold to fill four ticks for up to four arrows. Volley arrows deal 78% damage each.
primary.ui_brief: Tap for one arrow. Hold to fill four ticks for up to four arrows. Volley arrows deal 78% damage each.

secondary.name: Plant the Standard
secondary.description: Plant a flowering branch for 7 seconds. Press Secondary again to teleport back any number of times before it expires.
secondary.ui_brief: Plant a flowering branch for 7 seconds. Press Secondary again to teleport back any number of times before it expires.

special.name: Dawn Garden
special.description: Aim at the ground. A flowering tree erupts after a warning and leaves three shield pickups for you or your allies.
special.ui_brief: Aim at the ground. A flowering tree erupts after a warning and leaves three shield pickups for you or your allies.
